evidenceClasses.analysis-scope: A boundary against causal, predictive, recovery, identity, or Historical Load overclaiming.
evidenceClasses.declared-analysis-scope: An explicit history-window or non-claim boundary.
evidenceClasses.declared-equivalence-regime: One explicit answer to an equivalence question; no regime silently replaces another.
evidenceClasses.declared-projection: A bounded four-quantile vegetation-height projection, not full ecosystem state.
evidenceClasses.declared-rounding-profile: Projection-relative equality at a declared 0.1 m display precision.
evidenceClasses.matched-cell-comparison: A deterministic same-grid-cell comparison across the two surveys.
evidenceClasses.published-interpretation: A separately attributable tutorial interpretation connecting the tile and fire context.
evidenceClasses.recorded-temporal-context: A source-recorded event that precedes an observation without becoming a causal edge.
evidenceClasses.source-lock: Exact tutorial blobs, public file IDs, byte counts, and SHA-256 identities.
evidenceClasses.source-projected-measurement: A measurement projected from one exact source survey under the declared protocol.
